SELECT ct.course_offering_id, ct.usage_type, e.id, e.isbn10, e.isbn13, e.normalized_isbn, e.title, e.subtitle, e.authors, e.publisher, e.edition_label, e.published_year, e.cover_url, e.work_key, e.is_demo, AS on_sale_count FROM course_textbooks ct JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id = ct.course_offering_id AND o.active JOIN textbook_editions e ON e.id = ct.textbook_edition_id AND e.active WHERE ct.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND o.course_id = #{courseId} AND o.id = #{offeringId} ORDER BY ct.course_offering_id, CASE ct.usage_type WHEN 'REQUIRED' THEN 0 WHEN 'RECOMMENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, e.title COLLATE "C", e.id

SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, c.course_code, c.is_demo, o.id AS offering_id, o.academic_year, o.term, o.instructor_name, ct.usage_type FROM course_textbooks ct JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id = ct.course_offering_id AND o.active JOIN courses c ON c.id = o.course_id AND c.active WHERE ct.textbook_edition_id = #{editionId} AND ct.school_id = #{schoolId} AND ct.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' ORDER BY o.academic_year DESC, c.name COLLATE "C", o.id

SELECT e.id, e.normalized_isbn, e.title, e.edition_label, e.publisher, e.published_year, AS on_sale_count FROM textbook_editions e WHERE e.school_id = #{schoolId} AND e.work_key = #{workKey} AND e.id <> #{excludeId} AND e.active ORDER BY e.published_year DESC NULLS LAST, e.id
